test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the sentence using the correct phrasal verb of the underlined words.

The thieves managed to __get off__ the police during the chase.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **get away from**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"get off"** generally means to leave a place, vehicle, or avoid punishment. However, in the given sentence, it is incorrectly used. (छोड़ना, या बच निकलना)
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to get off the bus just before it started moving.
 
 
• The correct phrasal verb **"get away from"** means to escape or avoid capture. (भाग निकलना)
 
 
• **Example:** The thieves managed to get away from the police during the chase.
 
 
• Hence, the sentence should use **"get away from"** to correctly convey the meaning of escaping from the police.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **get away from**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: get along with** (साथ निभाना या मेलजोल करना) - Refers to having a good relationship or being friendly with someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She gets along with her colleagues very well.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: get over** (भूल जाना या संभल जाना) - Refers to recovering from something, such as an illness or emotional distress.
 
 
• **Example:** It took him months to get over the breakup.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: get through** (संपन्न करना या मुश्किल से गुजरना) - Refers to successfully completing something or surviving a difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example:** She managed to get through the tough exam with flying colors.
 
 
 
40:Tabc,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
